Screens never touch SecureStore or the native module directly: everything goes through lib/
api (fetch, JWT refresh, DTO types) · query + refresh + useRefreshOnFocus (cache) · secure (SecureStore) · pin
notifications (lock-card text, permission) · keepAlive (battery, Autostart) · phone (dial) · image (resize, SHA-256) · format
lib ⇄ store — api reads session tokens;
signOut clears the cache and lock card.
lib ⇄ i18n — notification text needs t();
i18n saves the language via lib/secure.
theme/ is imported by every screen.
api · errorKey · invalidateAfterEdit · refreshQueries · pin · phone · format (53)
express · drizzle-orm · zod · jose · pg / pglite · qrcode
initDb() then listen · createApp(): helmet, cors, pino-http, errorHandler · mounts every router under /api/v1
profile (profile, lists, card builder, lock-screen fields) · records (upload, dedupe, review) · extract (Gemini → Typhoon, retries)
share (links, passcodes, access log) · alerts (in-app + Resend e-mail) · notifications · consent (PDPA, withdraw, delete)
public (/e/:token rescuer card, /s/:token clinician page) · health
env (zod-validated) · AppContext { db, storage } handed to every router · errorHandler
Cross-module calls are few and one-way: public → profile (buildCardForUser), public → alerts (recordView);
auth → crypto (verifyPassword) and auth → db (users, refreshTokens); context wraps db + storage.
Layering quirk: alerts/ and storage/ import the HTTP retry helpers (withRetry, ProviderError) from modules/extract.
Every health text column passes through crypto/ before db/; route modules never see ciphertext.
